note: Status determined by codebase search (Assets/Scripts/Emuera/). parse_status reflects parser registration; runtime_status reflects instruction/method execution; render_status is N/A for non-visual commands. test_status is MISSING throughout — no automated test suite exists for these features.

parse.PARTIAL: parsed but edge cases or only one form
parse.MISSING: not parsed; crashes or errors if used

runtime.NO_OP: parsed but does nothing at runtime

HTML_Tags.name: img_src
HTML_Tags.notes: Parsed in HtmlManager.cs case 'img'; ConsoleImagePart created; src name resolved through AppContents.

HTML_Tags.name: img_srcb
HTML_Tags.description: Button-hover variant image via srcb attribute on
HTML_Tags.notes: srcb attribute parsed and stored in ConsoleImagePart (HtmlManager.cs:754). Unity renderer receives the value but hover/PointerEnter swap is not yet wired to UnityEngine input events.

HTML_Tags.name: img_srcm
HTML_Tags.description: Mask image via srcm attribute on
HTML_Tags.notes: srcm parsed and stored (HtmlManager.cs:760). SpriteGetColor used for per-pixel mask in ConsoleImagePart.cs:286. GraphicsSurface.GDrawGWithMask implements compositing.

HTML_Tags.name: img_flip
HTML_Tags.description: Horizontal/vertical image flip via negative width or height on
HTML_Tags.notes: Negative width/height stored as FlipH/FlipV flags in ConsoleImagePart (ConsoleImagePart.cs:72-73). GraphicsSurface handles GDI-style flip in blit path (GraphicsSurface.cs:180).

HTML_Tags.name: div
HTML_Tags.notes: Opening tag silently consumed (HtmlManager.cs:811-815 NYI stub). Closing tag silently ignored (HtmlManager.cs:635-637). Content renders inline with no block semantics.

HTML_Tags.name: clearbutton
HTML_Tags.notes: Tag parsed and silently consumed (HtmlManager.cs:812-815). Clearbutton behavior NYI per comment. No runtime effect.

HTML_Tags.name: button
HTML_Tags.notes: Fully implemented. ConsoleButtonString created with integer or string value. Stacks with font/style tags.

HTML_Tags.name: font
HTML_Tags.description: <font face='' color='' bcolor=''> font and color specification
HTML_Tags.notes: face, color, and bcolor attributes parsed (HtmlManager.cs:973-988). Nested font stacks supported (FonttagList). Closing </font> pops stack.

HTML_Tags.name: p_align
HTML_Tags.notes: Maps to ALIGNMENT command semantics. Line-start to line-end only; end tag optional. left/center/right values supported (HtmlManager.cs:711-718).

HTML_Tags.name: nobr
HTML_Tags.notes: Line-start only. Error thrown if used mid-line or twice. Equivalent to PRINTSINGLE semantics.

HTML_Tags.name: bius_styles
HTML_Tags.notes: Bold/Italic/Underline/Strikethrough via FontStyle flags. Correctly stacked and closed. Serialized to HTML round-trip in getStringStyleStartingTag.

HTML_Tags.name: shape
HTML_Tags.description: <shape type='rect|space|polygon' param='...' color='' bcolor=''> shape drawing
HTML_Tags.notes: ConsoleShapePart created. type, param, color, bcolor attributes handled (HtmlManager.cs:823-890). HTML_GETPRINTEDSTR round-trip via ConsoleShapePart serialization.

HTML_Tags.name: nonbutton
HTML_Tags.notes: title attribute and optional locked X position (PointXisLocked/PointX) parsed. Distinct from <button>; IsButtonTag=false.

HTML_Tags.name: br
HTML_Tags.notes: Sets FlagBr in HtmlAnalzeState; flushes current buffer to a new display line.

HTML_Instructions.name: HTML_PRINT
HTML_Instructions.description: Renders an HTML string to the console
HTML_Instructions.notes: Registered as HTML_PRINT_Instruction in FunctionIdentifier. Argument type SP_HTML_PRINT handles parsing. Calls Console.PrintHtml(str, toPrintBuffer).

HTML_Instructions.name: HTML_PRINT_second_arg
HTML_Instructions.description: HTML_PRINT optional second integer argument (non-zero = inject into print buffer)
HTML_Instructions.notes: SP_HTML_PRINT ArgumentBuilder parses optional int expression as OptTerm. Instraction.Child.cs reads arg.OptTerm and passes toPrintBuffer flag to PrintHtml.

HTML_Instructions.name: HTML_TAGSPLIT
HTML_Instructions.description: Splits an HTML string at tag boundaries into a string array
HTML_Instructions.notes: Registered as HTML_TAGSPLIT_Instruction in FunctionIdentifier. Calls HtmlManager.HtmlTagSplit(str) which returns string[].

HTML_Instructions.name: HTML_POPPRINTINGSTR
HTML_Instructions.description: Pops the current accumulated HTML printing string
HTML_Instructions.notes: Registered as HtmlPopPrintingStrMethod in Creator.cs. Returns the accumulated print string and clears it.

HTML_Instructions.name: HTML_GETPRINTEDSTR
HTML_Instructions.description: Returns the HTML representation of the last printed display line
HTML_Instructions.notes: Registered as HtmlGetPrintedStrMethod in Creator.cs. ConsoleImagePart and ConsoleShapePart both implement HTML serialization for round-trip correctness (ConsoleImagePart.cs:122-129).

HTML_Instructions.name: HTML_PRINT_ISLAND
HTML_Instructions.description: Starts an HTML island (deferred render region)
HTML_Instructions.notes: Not found anywhere in codebase. Not in BuiltInFunctionCode, FunctionIdentifier, or Creator.cs.

HTML_Instructions.name: HTML_PRINT_ISLAND_CLEAR
HTML_Instructions.description: Clears a previously opened HTML island
HTML_Instructions.notes: Not found anywhere in codebase. Not implemented.

HTML_Instructions.name: HTML_STRINGLINES
HTML_Instructions.description: Returns the number of display lines an HTML string occupies at a given width
HTML_Instructions.notes: Registered as HtmlStringLinesMethod in Creator.cs. Signature: HTML_STRINGLINES(str, width). Returns line count.

CBG_Commands.name: CBGSETG
CBG_Commands.description: Sets a G-surface image onto the CBG background layer at (x,y,zdepth)
CBG_Commands.notes: Registered as CBGSetGraphicsMethod in Creator.cs. Signature: CBGSETG(int ID, int x, int y, int zdepth).

CBG_Commands.name: CBGSETSPRITE
CBG_Commands.description: Sets a sprite image onto the CBG background layer
CBG_Commands.notes: Registered as CBGSetCIMGMethod in Creator.cs. Signature: CBGSETCIMG(str imgName, int x, int y, int zdepth).

CBG_Commands.name: CBGCLEAR
CBG_Commands.description: Clears all CBG background layer items

CBG_Commands.name: CBGREMOVERANGE
CBG_Commands.description: Removes CBG items within a z-depth range
CBG_Commands.notes: Registered as CBGRemoveRangeMethod. Signature: CBGREMOVERANGE(int zmin, int zmax).

CBG_Commands.name: CBGSETBMAPG
CBG_Commands.description: Sets a BMap G-surface onto the CBG background
CBG_Commands.notes: Registered as CBGSetBMapGMethod in Creator.cs. Signature: CBGSETBMAPG(int ID, int x, int y, int zdepth).

CBG_Commands.name: CBGSETBUTTONSPRITE
CBG_Commands.description: Associates a sprite with a CBG button slot
CBG_Commands.notes: Registered as CBGSETButtonSpriteMethod. Signature: CBGSETBUTTONSPRITE(int button, str imgName, str imgNameB, int x, int y, int zdepth, str tooltipmes).

Graphics_G.name: GCREATEFROMFILE
Graphics_G.description: Creates a graphics buffer from an image file
Graphics_G.notes: Registered as GraphicsCreateFromFileMethod. Copies pixel content from file into a new surface (GraphicsImage.cs:35).

Graphics_G.name: GDISPOSE
Graphics_G.description: Disposes a graphics buffer by ID

Graphics_G.name: GCLEAR
Graphics_G.description: Overwrites every pixel of a G-surface with a color
Graphics_G.notes: Registered as GraphicsClearMethod. GraphicsSurface.GClear overwrites all pixels (GraphicsSurface.cs:91).

Graphics_G.name: GFILLRECTANGLE
Graphics_G.description: Fills a rectangle on a G-surface with a color
Graphics_G.notes: Registered as GraphicsFillRectangleMethod. Clips to surface bounds. Signature: GFILLRECTANGLE(ID, cARGB, x, y, w, h).

Graphics_G.name: GDRAWG
Graphics_G.description: Blits one G-surface onto another with optional color matrix
Graphics_G.notes: Registered as GraphicsDrawGMethod. Supports optional CM (color matrix) argument. Alpha compositing handled (GraphicsSurface.cs:16).

Graphics_G.name: GDRAWGWITHMASK
Graphics_G.description: Draws G-surface onto another using a mask surface
Graphics_G.notes: Registered as GraphicsDrawGWithMaskMethod. Mask alpha scales source opacity per pixel (GraphicsSurface.cs:280).

Graphics_G.name: GSETCOLOR
Graphics_G.description: Sets a single pixel color on a G-surface
Graphics_G.notes: Registered as GraphicsSetColorMethod. Overwrites single pixel ignoring alpha compositing (GraphicsSurface.cs:83).

Graphics_G.name: GGETCOLOR
Graphics_G.description: Gets the color of a single pixel from a G-surface
Graphics_G.notes: Registered as GraphicsGetColorMethod in Creator.cs (Creator.cs:175). Returns ARGB packed integer.

Graphics_G.name: GSETBRUSH
Graphics_G.description: Sets the brush used for fill operations on a G-surface
Graphics_G.notes: Registered as GraphicsSetBrushMethod. Stores Brush on GraphicsImage (GraphicsImage.cs:170).

Graphics_G.name: GSETPEN
Graphics_G.description: Sets the pen used for line drawing on a G-surface
Graphics_G.notes: Registered as GraphicsSetPenMethod. Stores Pen on GraphicsImage (GraphicsImage.cs:175). Pen set but GDRAWLINE not implemented, so pen is currently unused.

Graphics_G.name: GDRAWLINE
Graphics_G.description: Draws a line on a G-surface using the current pen
Graphics_G.notes: NOT registered in Creator.cs or FunctionIdentifier. GSETPEN exists but GDRAWLINE has no implementation. CompatibilityScanner mentions GDRAW prefix commands but GDRAWLINE is absent from all registries.

Graphics_G.name: GSAVE
Graphics_G.description: Saves a G-surface to a file slot
Graphics_G.notes: Registered as GraphicsSaveMethod in Creator.cs. Signature: GSAVE(int ID, int fileNo).

Graphics_G.name: GLOAD
Graphics_G.description: Loads a G-surface from a file slot
Graphics_G.notes: Registered as GraphicsLoadMethod in Creator.cs. Signature: GLOAD(int ID, int fileNo).

Sprite_Commands.name: SPRITEANIMEANIMESTART_STOP
Sprite_Commands.description: Starts or stops a sprite animation playback
Sprite_Commands.notes: SPRITEANIMEANIMESTART and SPRITEANIMEANIMESTOP are not registered anywhere. SPRITEANIMECREATE, SPRITEANIMEADDFRAME, and SETANIMETIMER exist but play/stop control is absent.

Sprite_Commands.name: SPRITECREATE
Sprite_Commands.description: Creates a sprite from a region of a G-surface
Sprite_Commands.notes: Registered as SpriteCreateMethod. Signature: SPRITECREATE(str imgName, int gID[, int x, int y, int w, int h]).

Sprite_Commands.name: SPRITEGETINFO
Sprite_Commands.description: Returns information about a sprite (width, height, etc.)
Sprite_Commands.notes: Not registered anywhere. Individual properties (SPRITEWIDTH, SPRITEHEIGHT, SPRITEPOSX, SPRITEPOSY, SPRITECREATED) exist as SpriteStateMethod entries.

Sprite_Commands.name: SPRITEEXIST
Sprite_Commands.description: Returns whether a named sprite exists
Sprite_Commands.notes: Not registered. Functional equivalent SPRITECREATED (SpriteStateMethod) is registered and returns 1/0 for sprite existence. Games using SPRITEEXIST will fail.

Sprite_Commands.name: SPRITEGETCOLOR
Sprite_Commands.description: Gets the pixel color from a sprite at (x, y)
Sprite_Commands.notes: Registered as SpriteGetColorMethod. Uses ASprite.SpriteGetColor(x, y) - implemented on both CroppedImage and SpriteAnime.

Save_Load.name: SAVEGAME_LOADGAME
Save_Load.description: Opens the save/load screen (shop context only)
Save_Load.notes: Registered as SAVELOADGAME_Instruction (shared for both). Throws CodeEE if called inside @SHOW_SHOP. Only valid in shop context.

Save_Load.name: SAVEDATA_LOADDATA
Save_Load.description: Saves/loads game data to a numbered slot
Save_Load.notes: SAVEDATA uses SP_SAVEDATA ArgumentBuilder (slot + description string). LOADDATA takes INT_EXPRESSION. Process.ScriptProc.cs handles execution.

Save_Load.name: SAVEVAR_LOADVAR
Save_Load.notes: Registered as SAVEVAR_Instruction/LOADVAR_Instruction. SP_SAVEVAR ArgumentBuilder handles variable list. Character variables rejected with explicit error (use SAVECHARA).

Save_Load.name: SAVECHARA_LOADCHARA
Save_Load.notes: Registered as SAVECHARA_Instruction/LOADCHARA_Instruction. SP_SAVECHARA handles variable-length chara index list.

Save_Load.name: DELDATA_CHKDATA
Save_Load.description: Deletes a save slot / checks if a save slot contains valid data
Save_Load.notes: DELDATA registered as DELDATA_Instruction. CHKDATA registered as CheckdataMethod in Creator.cs (Creator.cs:41). Both support numeric and filename-based addressing.

Save_Load.name: binary_save_1808
Save_Load.notes: EraBinaryDataReader1808 and EraBinaryDataWriter implement full binary serialization (EraBinaryDataReader.cs:146, EraBinaryDataWriter.cs:27). Magic constant Version1808=1808.

Save_Load.name: text_save_format
Save_Load.notes: EraDataReader/EraDataWriter handle text-based save files. EMU_1808_START marker separates header sections. Both formats supported simultaneously.

Input.name: INPUT_INPUTS
Input.notes: Registered as INPUT_Instruction and INPUTS_Instruction in FunctionIdentifier (FunctionIdentifier.cs:190-191).

Input.name: TINPUT_TINPUTS
Input.notes: Registered as TINPUT_Instruction(false) and TINPUTS_Instruction(false). TONEINPUT/TONEINPUTS use same classes with one-input flag=true.

Input.name: ONEINPUT_ONEINPUTS
Input.notes: Registered as ONEINPUT_Instruction/ONEINPUTS_Instruction. SP_ONEINPUT handles nument (multi-digit behavior flag).

Input.name: TONEINPUT_TONEINPUTS
Input.notes: Registered as TINPUT_Instruction(true)/TINPUTS_Instruction(true). Shares implementation with TINPUT, differs in one-input semantics.

Input.name: FLOWINPUT
Input.notes: Not found anywhere in codebase — not in BuiltInFunctionCode, FunctionIdentifier, or Creator.cs.

Input.name: MOUSEB_GETKEY
Input.description: Mouse button state / keyboard key state queries
Input.notes: GETKEY and GETKEYTRIGGERED registered as GetKeyStateMethod (Creator.cs:164-165). MOUSEB as a standalone function is not registered; INPUTMOUSEKEY (FunctionIdentifier.cs:380) covers mouse-key combined input. MOUSEX/MOUSEY listed in CompatibilityScanner input group.

DataTable_DT.name: DT_any
DataTable_DT.notes: No DT_ prefixed commands found anywhere in the codebase. DataTable feature is entirely absent.

MAP_Commands.name: MAP_any
MAP_Commands.notes: No MAP_ prefixed commands found anywhere in the codebase. MAP feature is entirely absent.

XML_Commands.name: XML_any
XML_Commands.notes: No XML_ prefixed commands found anywhere in the codebase. XML feature is entirely absent.

ERD_Named_Indices.name: ERD_named_array_indices
ERD_Named_Indices.description: Named array index definitions via .erd files (NAMEDEFINE / NameDef)
ERD_Named_Indices.notes: No .erd file extension recognized; NAMEDEFINE/NAMEDEF not found in any loader (ErbLoader, HeaderFileLoader). ERD support is entirely absent. STRNAME/TSTRNAME/SAVESTRNAME CSV loading exists but is unrelated.
